cases.text: Patient denies suicidal ideation, plan or intent at today's visit.
Columbia suicide severity rating completed. Passive death wish last month, no active plan, safety plan reviewed.
Healed superficial self-inflicted lacerations on the left forearm. Referred to behavioral health.
Patient reports wanting to kill himself during last week's depressive episode. Now on sertraline and feeling safer.
Denies homicidal ideation. Admits to thoughts of hanging himself two years ago, none since starting therapy.
Intentional ingestion of 30 tablets of amitriptyline. Psychiatry consulted for suicide risk assessment.
PHQ-9 item 9 positive: thoughts of being better off dead on several days.
Long-standing Parkinson's disease with worsening resting tremor. Continue carbidopa-levodopa.
Biopsy consistent with Hodgkin lymphoma, nodular sclerosis subtype.
Exacerbation of Crohn's disease. Started on a prednisone taper.
Glasgow Coma Scale 14 on arrival. Babinski sign negative bilaterally.
Foley catheter placed. Whipple procedure scheduled after staging.
Serology positive for Lyme disease after a tick bite. Doxycycline for 21 days.
Findings suggest Hashimoto thyroiditis. Started levothyroxine.
Takes St. John's wort over the counter, which interacts with warfarin.
Acute onset Bell's palsy affecting the right side of the face.
Guillain-Barre syndrome suspected after Campylobacter infection. Admit for IVIG.
History of Graves' disease treated with radioactive iodine. Now hypothyroid.
Exposure history raises concern for West Nile virus. Epstein-Barr serology pending.
Apgar scores 8 and 9. Moro reflex intact. Mongolian spot over the sacrum.
Mallory-Weiss tear on endoscopy. Hemostasis achieved with Bakri balloon backup not needed.
Opioid overdose. Naloxone 2 mg given intranasally with good response.
Urine drug screen positive for cocaine and methamphetamine. Counselled on cessation.
Lethal dose range reviewed with pharmacy before starting colchicine, given reduced renal function.
Heroin use disorder, injects daily. Offered buprenorphine and clean needle resources.
Fentanyl patch 25 mcg/hr for cancer pain, morphine for breakthrough pain.
Alcohol withdrawal with tremor and hallucinations. CIWA protocol with lorazepam started.
Acetaminophen toxicity. Level above the treatment line, N-acetylcysteine started.
Pediatric exam for suspected physical abuse. Skeletal survey ordered and child protective services notified.
Forensic exam after reported sexual assault. Kit collected with consent, prophylaxis offered.
Patient discloses being beaten by her partner. Bruising across the back, domestic violence advocate contacted.
Eight-year-old with genital bruising inconsistent with the reported fall. Mandatory report filed.
Elder neglect suspected: stage 4 sacral pressure injury and severe dehydration.
Sexually active with two male partners, inconsistent condom use. Screened for gonorrhea and chlamydia.
Pelvic exam: vaginal discharge, cervical motion tenderness. Treated for PID.
Erectile dysfunction and premature ejaculation for six months. Penile exam normal.
Digital rectal exam: enlarged prostate, no masses. Anal fissure noted at 6 o'clock.
Medication abortion completed at 8 weeks. Breasts tender, nipple discharge resolved.
Gunshot wound to the abdomen, massive hemorrhage. Taken to the OR for exploratory laparotomy.
Morbidly obese patient with stupid amounts of ascites, per surgeon. Paracentesis drained 8 liters.
Patient shouted that the nurse was an idiot and threatened to hit staff. Security called, haloperidol given.
Stab wound to the chest with a kitchen knife. Bleeding controlled, chest tube placed.
Fetal demise at 34 weeks. Dead tissue debrided from the necrotic wound on the left foot.
